'''Crix Griff''' was a [[Con artist/Legends|con man]] who lived on [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]]. Griff was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] of medium build, with thinning brown hair and a thoroughly nondescript appearance. He also used a great many number of disguises, and could alter his appearance with ease. Sometimes, he simply fleeced people of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] after befriending them. More often, though, he set people up to take a fall for other criminals. Boss [[Kaggle]] or another criminal would sometimes contact Griff and hire him as a "fall man" for a mission that they were undertaking.
